carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary horizontal ridges are visible; one running along the mid-line and another along the upper third of the flank, both exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-frequency distribution of significantly smaller white spots is present on the cranial region and the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
